query_text: There are four parties to a Deed of Partition relating to a property in Tangalle, to be executed before a Notary licensed to practise in Colombo. One party resides in Tangalle and is unable to come to Colombo; the other three reside in Colombo. Discuss how all parties may sign the Deed of Partition.
